Escape to the Serenity of the Lime & Coconut Beach House!

Reserve your Bachelorette Party now and enjoy a complimentary Bachelorette Decoration Kit with advance notice!


Step Into Lime & Coconut -a beautifully decorated vacation home, perfect for the entire family. Set the scene for your vacation memories in this meticulously maintained, spacious three-level retreat. Enjoy inviting gathering areas, balconies and porches for serene escapes—ideal for family and friends. It's casual, quiet, and brimming with character."

This newly furnished three-bedroom home includes two king master suites, one of which also features four twin bunk beds. The socializing area can be converted into a queen master suite with a comfortable queen sleeper sofa and a full bathroom. The second level boasts an open concept living and dining area, a beautiful and spacious kitchen, and a screened patio. The garage has been transformed into an exciting game room, complete with three TVs, two cozy sofas, a Lazy Boy chair, a shuffleboard table, three arcade machines, a ring toss game, cornhole, Jenga, and a selection of board games.

Inlet Beach is known for its laid-back and carefree mood, joining the 30A Beaches with its quaint charm and unhurried pace. Indulge in shopping, dining, and attractions at nearby spots like Rosemary Beach and Pier Park. Bike or walk to the nearby Inlet Beach public access point and onto the stunning Gulf beach with its sugary white sand and sparkling Emerald Green water.

House Guidelines:

Please treat the property with care and respect.

Check-In: 4:00 PM Check-Out: 10:00 AM

Basic starter supplies are provided for your convenience. If you have a larger party, please plan accordingly.

Report any property damage or maintenance needs immediately. In case of emergencies, call 911 first, then notify the property managers.

House Rules:

No parties or events allowed.

No overnight street parking is permitted.

Keep noise levels down after 10:00 PM to respect the neighborhood community.

Ensure the grills are clean before leaving.

Please only use "Command strips" on walls,

Avoid jumping on beds, or damaging walls or furniture.

No Pets.

Secure your stay at The Lime and Coconut today and enjoy all that Inlet Beach, Rosemary Beach, and 30A have to offer! Your perfect vacation home awaits you.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: I have been coming to the 30A area for just over 20 years and really enjoyed this new community. Great location and there was a nice pool included in the neighborhood which is something we always look for. A golf cart rental made it quick and easy to access the beach. The home itself was very clean and included alot of amenities which made for a very comfortable stay for our family of 6

reviews.text: We absolutely LOVED this home for my bachelorette trip. Even better than the pictures! It was so clean, quiet, and had so many amenities. The host is amazing and even got us bride and bridesmaid glasses and self-care bags! She’s so sweet. Perfect location to inlet or rosemary beach. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Stacy B.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: If I could give this VRBO rental 100 stars, I would! While the photos on the listing are nice, we were absolutely wowed from the moment we walked through the front door. This home is gorgeous! And such a perfect place for entertaining - with grills, a sports bar-like entertainment room with games and shuffleboard, TVs EVERYWHERE, a firepit, wine fridges, etc. We loved all the beach decor, too!I was on a senior Spring Break trip with my daughter and five of her friends, so the room with bunk beds was the ideal place for them all to sleep. The owner, Carol, went above and beyond by leaving the sweetest welcome gift for all of us - wine and snacks for me, and monogrammed cups and bracelets for my daughter and her friends. So kind and thoughtful!The house is in an ideal location, just across the road from the public access walkway to Inlet Beach. It's walkable, but we were able to drive and find parking every day. The house was well-stocked with beach chairs, beach towels, an umbrella, a tent, sand toys and even a large rolling cooler to make our visit easy!We had an amazing trip from start to finish and can't wait to go back. I haven't been this impressed with a 30A beach rental in a long time! Thanks so much for everything.
